description: Single-player simulation phases and lifetime checks; no playable-game, host scheduling or complete-game FPS claim.

order.reference: Hash-pinned original P_Ticker compiled as host C. Single-player, menu inactive, 16 four-tic pause sequences at four starting clocks; the deathmatch-only item-respawn stage is inert.

scope: Player use/secret effects precede newly created door thinkers.
Animation/scrolling precedes button expiry; one common level clock advances last.
Pause and pending exits stop further tics; later same-tic exit requests overwrite earlier ones.
Player and weapon bob use the same level clock.
Context/clock bounds, reentry and six world-owner destructor guards.
Exceptions retain prior effects, release active guards and permit cleanup.
No eager pixel reads/cache allocation; own-task heap returns to its baseline.
integration.taskIsolation: HEMU uses its ordinary fresh-task launch API, matching the native oracle. Native throw logs to Adam; running heap assertions inside Adam would count those document allocations.

images.scope: Static images/cache/read/actor counts and animated pixel hashes remain unchanged. Animated expected-frame depth comparisons pass independently in each backend.

remaining: Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
